newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Intense earthquake recorded in the Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Intense earthquake recorded in the Philippines.

text.p: An intense earthquake measuring 6.2 on the Richter scale was recorded 280 kilometres east-southeast of Cebu, Philippines on Friday morning, the Royal Hong Kong Observatory said.
The quake struck at 8.07 a.m. (0007 GMT), it said.
The epicentre was initially determined to be off the northeast coast of Mindanao, Philippine Islands about 280 km east-southeast of Cebu at 9.6 N 126.4 E, the observatory said.
